status.summary: MEGA Fanling is a commercial data centre serving one cloud customer. SUNeVision reported on 1 September 2026 that it remained fully operational and occupied, supporting that customer’s cloud business.

locator.identity_review: The EPD December 2025 waste-programme member list names MEGA Fanling at 11 On Chuen Street. SUNeVision’s FY2026 annual report identifies iAdvantage’s data-centre lease of the whole building at that exact address on Fanling Sheung Shui Town Lot No. 2. CSDI uniquely maps FSSTL 2 to LotCSUID 500000002. The government address service’s exact No.11 result independently falls inside the lot. Adjacent iTech Tower 3.2 at No.8 is FSSTL 288 and is excluded.
locator.uncertainty_reason: LandsD gives no measured positional tolerance for the lot boundary. Its bounds span about 66.0 by 65.8 m; agreement between government coordinate-transform outputs does not establish survey accuracy.

additions.distinctness_review: No exact name, address or FSSTL 2 identity exists in the current 62 dataset. The nearest site, iTech Tower 3.2, is about 84 m away at 8 On Chuen Street on FSSTL 288; iTech Tower 3.1 is at 3 On Kui Street on FSSTL 289. MEGA Fanling is separately named and operated by iAdvantage at No.11 on FSSTL 2. Different addresses, parcels and operators establish distinct identity.

additions.name: MEGA Plus — existing commercial data-centre operations

status.summary: MEGA Plus is SUNeVision’s commercial data centre in Tseung Kwan O. On 1 September 2026, the operator reported that it was effectively fully occupied and directing new demand to the separate MEGA IDC facility.

locator.precision: Government address point for MEGA PLUS at 299 Wan Po Road, on Tseung Kwan O Town Lot No. 122. This marks the facility address, not a building outline, entrance or data hall. The adjacent MEGA IDC on Lot No. 131 is a separate Atlas site.
locator.identity_review: The operator’s facility page identifies MEGA Plus at 299 Wan Po Road. The government Address Lookup Service returns one exact feature carrying both that facility name and numbered address. The annual report separately lists MEGA Plus on TKOTL 122 and MEGA IDC on TKOTL 131. The ALS point lies inside the CSDI Lot 122 polygon.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The address-service response does not supply measured positional accuracy or survey metadata. Five decimal places are source precision, not surveyed accuracy.

additions.distinctness_review: MEGA Plus is absent from the current 62 dataset. Existing MEGA IDC (vcc-site-a3cba6e8a69870f1cfeb) is at 297 Wan Po Road/TKOTL 131 and only covers IDC Phase One. The annual report lists Plus and IDC separately with different service years, floor areas and lots; the Plus operator page expressly describes an adjacent separate new site. The operator’s MEGA Campus is a network spanning several Hong Kong districts, not one physical property. Therefore admit MEGA Plus as a distinct physical site, preserving IDC unchanged. Parcel comparison independently excludes overlapping lots and places the Plus address point inside Lot 122 only. Lots 122 and 131 abut along 178.23 m of common boundary; they are not separated by a gap. Their polygon intersection area is zero, and the ALS Plus point is about 39.11 m outside Lot 131.

additions.name: (仮称)HND12新築工事 — planned Toyosu data-centre building

status.summary: HND12 is a planned six-storey commercial data centre on the former KR Toyosu property in Tokyo. Digital Tokyo Bay 1 TMK presented the proposal on 6 and 7 August 2026: approximately 24,000 m² of gross floor area on a 6,689.30 m² property, designed by Kume Sekkei and intended to be operated by MC Digital Realty. Preparation is planned from November 2026, construction from January 2027 to August 2029, and phased operations from August 2029 onward while fit-out continues. These dates are forecasts.

locator.precision: Exact GSI residential-address feature for Toyosu 5-4-9, at the southeast street edge of the former KR Toyosu Building property. Labelled parent-property address marker; not a new data-centre building centroid, surveyed entrance, legal boundary or active-work extent.
locator.identity_review: The developer’s original briefing names Toyosu 5-chome lots 2-15 and 2-63 on pages 2 and 4, and explicitly gives residential address Toyosu 5-4-9 on pages 17 and 18. GSI returns that exact full address as one feature. The MOJ/AIGID 2026 dataset contains exactly those adjoining lots; map and imagery inspection places the GSI point at their southeast street edge and the same parent property shown on briefing page 2. The separately photographed posted notice corroborates the same lots, address and client; the exact address bridge does not depend on its third-party host.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The GSI address feature supplies no positional accuracy or datum realization. The point marks a property address near its southeast edge, not the planned building. Decimal places do not establish survey precision.

additions.distinctness_review: Checked all five current62 tables, including 656 sites and 698 projects, and all tracked holds for HND12, full-width forms, Digital Tokyo Bay, KR Toyosu, Toyosu and 豊洲. No matching project/site/hold exists; only an unrelated Toyosu head-office warning for AT TOKYO appears. Nearest admitted site is Ariake TK2 at 2.206 km; Sengoku is 3.438 km away. Shiohama Phase II, Ariake TK2 and the planned Tokyo Bay/other HND campuses have distinct properties and are not merged. Exact checks and distances are in dedup-review.json.
additions.successor_review: Reviewed the developer’s live project site and briefing page on 25 October 2026. Website opening is explicitly 18 September; no newer physical milestone, issued development consent or achieved operation is established. The current overview retains January 2027 building start, November 2026 preparation and August 2029 building completion as forecasts. additions.name: CIDC Ulanqab Zero-Carbon Computing Base — existing commercial data-centre operations

status.summary: CIDC’s Ulanqab Zero-Carbon Computing Base is an operating commercial data-centre campus in the Bayin area of Chahar High-Tech Zone. In a 17 October 2026 report, operations head Li Chunxiao confirmed that its computing resources had supported training of several large models. He described coordinated wind, solar and storage supply to keep computing output stable. This entry covers existing campus operations; further development is separate.

locator.precision: Campus marker at the centre of the existing 220kV user substation inside the northwest part of CIDC’s Ulanqab zero-carbon computing base. This marks the named parent campus, not an individual data hall, entrance or campus centroid.
locator.identity_review: The 2026 EIA repeatedly names 中金数据乌兰察布零碳算力基地 and its owner 中金数据（乌兰察布）有限公司, explicitly says the station lies inside the northwest part of that campus, and Figure2 draws both boundaries. The substation and road/building/pond arrangement match independent WGS84 imagery. The earlier power-line endpoint lies about65m north of this centre; the remote generating-side step-up station is excluded. The separate later 京蒙绿色算力产业园二期 project is not merged here.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The EIA publishes milliarcsecond coordinate digits but no survey accuracy or explicit datum for this centre. Coordinates are converted from DMS without a datum shift; WGS84 is a mapping interpretation corroborated by the same property pattern in georeferenced imagery, not a datum declaration in the EIA. Campus-level scope and unknown accuracy are retained.
